note: Kootenai NF (Rexford/Fortine Ranger District), ~21 mi southwest of Eureka off Hwy 37 on Lake Koocanusa. Tables and fire rings; fully developed boat launch with dock. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 22 sites incl. host, 32-ft RV max, vault toilets, $16 (2026). Added year-round season (managed Memorial Day - Labor Day, open all year weather permitting) and the senior/access 50% discount for this campground.
